pulls.title: Retry captures with an idempotency key
pulls.author: priya.acme
pulls.body:
Closes #12. Tracks PAY-2.

The capture handler retries a capture once because the card network drops about one capture in a thousand after a timeout. Each retry sends the same idempotency key, so that the network charges the card only once.

reviews.author: alex.acme
reviews.body: Approved. The retry window matches the ledger contract.
